# MotoFit 2 — Complete Motorcycle Workshop Intelligence & Specification Guide

## 1. Company Overview
MotoFit 2 is an elite motorcycle garage located in Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, India. Engineered by motorcycle technicians with over a decade of track and street experience, MotoFit 2 rejects temporary quick-fixes ("jugaad") in favor of aerospace-grade micrometer tolerances, dynamic OBD-2 computer diagnostics, and dynamometer-verified calibrations.

## 2. Location & Geographic Service Area
- Physical Address: Shop No 9, Kirtan Complex, Nigam Nagar, Near New CG Road, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424
- Pin Code: 382424
- Service Neighborhoods: Chandkheda, Motera, Sabarmati, New CG Road, Zundal, Tragad, Gift City, Gandhinagar, S.G. Highway, Naroda, Kalol, Vastrapur, Bodakdev, Prahlad Nagar, Nikol.
- Recovery Support: Hydraulic flatbed bike pickup and drop available within a 30km radius of Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar.

## 3. Core Service Packages & Diagnostic Protocols
### 3.1 1-Year Engine Guarantee Rebuilds
- Includes full teardown, cylinder honing, ultrasonic decarbonization, crankshaft truing, valve lapping, new OEM oil seals, high-temp gaskets, and break-in dyno cycle.
- Warranty: 365 Days on full-engine rebuilds / 8 Months on half-engine top-end rebuilds.

### 3.2 ECU Remapping & Custom Dyno Tuning
- Tailored fuel injection maps, throttle-by-wire latency elimination, RPM rev-limiter adjustment, fan-trigger temperature lowering for Ahmedabad summers (preventing city overheating in KTMs and European superbikes).
- Hardware: Custom dyno cell with eddy-current absorption brake and wideband O2 lambda datalogging.

### 3.3 Superbike Maintenance
- Supported Brands: Ducati, Kawasaki, BMW Motorrad, Triumph, Harley-Davidson, Honda BigWing, Yamaha, Suzuki, KTM, Aprilia, Benelli.
- Consumables: Motul 300V Factory Line 15W50 / 10W40, Brembo sintered pads, Bel-Ray fork oil, Motul Dot 5.1 racing brake fluid.
